positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
* Designed brand new products and process flows for Q2’s ETL department with the help of Python, MySQL, T-SQL, shell scripting, and proprietary APIs, between other technologies
* Created, tested, and implemented moderately complex and custom ETL solutions 
* Mentored colleagues by answering process architecture and general development questions
* Offered technical expertise by being part of Q2’s ETL department RFQ process
* Demonstrated flexibility by working after hours when needed, including weekends

positions.title: Data Services Implementations Engineer III
positions.description:
* Implemented and troubleshot Q2’s ETL processes with the extensive use of Python and T-SQL
* Designed and developed product extensions for brand new ETL requests
* Exhibited ambitiousness and drive by tackling some of the more complex projects in Q2’s ETL dept.
* Expressed dependability by consistently delivering projects on a timely manner
* Displayed strong communication and teamwork skills by properly coordinating project execution/changes with the customers and the rest of the teams
* Demonstrated flexibility by working after hours when needed, including weekends
* Expressed resourcefulness by self-learning new skills (e.g., AWS, Bash, Linux, dev. best practices) and applying these in the field

positions.title: Systems Implementation Engineer I
positions.description:
* Demonstrated reliability by installing and customizing intricate software systems for environmental compliant customers
* Displayed efficiency and timeliness by completing implementation projects in a timely fashion
* Exhibited strong communication and teamwork skills by properly coordinating project execution/changes with customers and by discussing projects’ scopes/methods with assigned Sr. team engineers
* Showed competence by resolving customers’ issues on a day-to-day basis. These ranged from software functionality to environmental compliance questions
* Conveyed strong time management skills by working with multiple projects at the same time
* Expressed resourcefulness by self-teaching new skills (e.g., PowerShell, Windows Command Line, T-SQL, XML) and applying these in the field (e.g., database modifications, automation)
* Experience with Windows Server and SQL Server custom installations, database migrations, server management, controllers’ hardware, and network design/communication
* Offered training in the shape of conferences and webinars
* Exhibited flexibility by working with customers’ schedules, including weekends

positions.title: Independent Contractor
positions.description:
* Demonstrated dependability by being in charge of picking up newspapers at The Brownsville Herald warehouse location and delivering them to different stores throughout the city everyday.
* Proved trustworthiness by retrieving unsold newspapers from such stores and returning them to the warehouse at the end of each week.
* Showed competence by filling reports regarding the number of newspapers not sold for the different versions of The Brownsville Herald.

positions.title: Tutor & Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
* Helped students clarify and understand various engineering subject materials by implementing one to one and group review sessions.
* Became a mentor to some of the students, not only by supporting them in their courses, but also offering essential advice in how to be successful in their university career.
* Assisted an engineering professor in the grading of homework.

positions.title: Staff Services
positions.description:
* Displayed accountability by properly conducting walk around sessions throughout the condos and filling reports regarding aesthetic (lights, trash) conditions of these.
* Proved responsibility by allowing only the tenants of the condos to enter Sunchase Beachfront property.

positions.title: Lab & Teacher Assistant
positions.description:
* Assisted engineering professors in the grading of homework and the maintenance of different laboratories.
* Demonstrated reliability and trustworthiness by turning in all grades on their respective due dates.
* Showed flexibility by performing my primary responsibilities plus completing any extra duties assigned with the purpose of helping UTB’s engineering department.

positions.title: Sales Associate Cashier
positions.description:
* Energetically greeted customers and charged for their items in a fast and efficient way.
* Demonstrated sales competency by fulfilling the required daily sales quota of the store.
* Practiced approachability by treating customers in a friendly and responsive manner whenever they needed help finding a store product.

positions.title: Cashier
positions.description:
* Respectfully greeted customers and took orders in both a professional and an efficient way.
* Assumed team-leader responsibilities by making sure everything went as planned and as effectively as possible (cleaning, preparation of food, customer service).
* Positively affected my boss, co-workers, and customers by positioning responsibility, understanding, and efficiency before everything else.
* Showed accessibility by always practicing punctuality and giving a hand when extra workers were needed.

projects.title: Alternate Clothing Washing or Sanitizing System for Long Duration Space Missions - NASA Project
projects.description: A team consisting of students in the fields of computer science, computer engineering, mechanical engineering, and bioengineering were responsible of brainstorming and ultimately creating a prototype (CAD design) for an innovative method of cleaning cloth garments for astronauts in case of prolonged space missions. A nano-active sanitizing procedure was chosen for the final product of the design due to its efficiency in terms of water usage, above all.

projects.title: Conceptual Development of an Underwater Plane - Senior Design Project
projects.description: A team consisting of four engineering students, two computer engineers and two mechanical engineers, conceptualized, designed, and finally materialized an underwater plane with the shape of a submarine. The completion of this project required skills in the areas of programming, circuit design, 3-D modeling, and fluid mechanics.
